results.title: Bastards: Where´s Majer?
results.overview: Teacher Majer is lured by his friend to an old farmhouse, where a hitman hired by the last surviving member of the Dostál family is waiting for him. Meanwhile, everyone is waiting for Majer at the newly opened school, which he is supposed to manage. All of his former students wait in vain for Majer; he never arrives. No one understands what has happened, and above all, where the man is on whom they are now completely dependent, each for a different reason. They begin to fear that something has happened to Majer, and so the four “bravest” among them decide to find him.

results.title: The Neighbor
results.overview: A single mother confides in her trusted neighbor when a fellow resident ignores her repeated rejections. His guidance gives way to a protective resolve that could change their three lives forever.

results.title: Плохой сон
results.overview: Vitya had a nightmare. Again. Masha reassures him—it was just a dream, nothing bad will happen. But for some reason, Vitya feels like the bad dream hasn't gone away.

results.title: Asteroid-77F
results.overview: On a remote asteroid lost in deep space, where the lifeblood of interstellar war - the precious resource known as neoleum - is extracted, three workers find themselves caught in events that challenge everything they once believed. Trapped within a labyrinth of iron and concrete, the heroes must find a way to survive and unravel the truth behind the chaos.

results.title: Death Wears Your Eyes
results.overview: A masked man plunges into the shadows of a remote darkroom nightclub. Speakers throb as bodies collide to the pulse of industrial music. Amid the crowd, his eyes locks onto a boy with a defiant, hypnotic gaze. To possess him is an all-consuming need—yet this obsession weaves a cage where hunter and prey become prisoners of their own hunger.

results.title: When a Witness Recants
results.overview: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

results.title: threeASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE
results.overview: For threeASFOUR, fashion is an act of creativity, collaboration and cultural connection. But after more than two decades of acclaim, can three artists who refuse to sell out survive in an industry built on compromise?

results.title: Always & Forever
results.overview: An obsessive, controlling teenager kidnaps her boyfriend to play a bizarre, self-destructive game. But things become complicated when the boy demands a stop.

results.title: Love Love: Fractures
results.overview: Love doesn’t break all at once. Nine standalone stories catch it in the moment of fracture, from a bedroom argument to cross-border espionage, from quiet grief to genre worlds, and in the long, stubborn work of finding our way back.

results.title: Prince
results.overview: A devoted butler inherits his late employer's mansion - but only until her cherished Afghan Greyhound dies. As he settles in with the dog, greedy relatives scheme to disrupt their peaceful arrangement.

results.title: ARASHI LIVE TOUR 2026 「We are ARASHI」
results.overview: Livestream of the final tour of J-pop group, Arashi.

results.title: Shirley MacLaine, comme un torrent
results.overview: With her short red hair, expressive face, vitality, and playful acting style, Shirley MacLaine stands out in the Hollywood pantheon. Driven by a volcanic personality and iron discipline inherited from classical dance, she has constantly reinvented herself, from the girl next door to the eccentric old lady she plays on screen today, proving at 91 that there is a place for actresses of all ages. A refreshing portrait featuring film clips and archival footage, particularly those in which this talk show regular exercises her sharp wit.

results.title: Boris Is Dead
results.overview: A struggling actor, working as a waiter, unwittingly becomes involved in a violent heist gone wrong, where his boss—deep in debt—has been stealing from employees and running the restaurant as a front for the mob.

results.title: Shush, Now
results.overview: A seven year old girl discovers her mum is having an affair.

results.title: João Bosco Quartet Live in Birdland Jazz Club
results.original_title: João Bosco Quartet Live in Birdland Jazz Club

results.title: Can-doist
results.overview: This documentary follows vegan animal rights activists who have led the Korean animal rights movement for the past decade. Beyond advocating for pets, they fight for the rights of farmed and captive animals, striving for a world where all beings coexist. From rescuing pigs and dolphins to challenging the system, they have built a movement.

results.title: Trevor Lies
results.overview: The bizarre tale of a young boy and his puritan family who must grapple with the morality and consequences of deceit

results.title: Dear Diary
results.overview: The innocent lines of a young girl’s diary recount the visit of her father’s colleagues, the games played in the garden, and the weight of the summer heat through her naïve perspective. Yet, when a “snowflake” falls onto her notebook, it slowly begins to reveal traces of another, unseen reality. What starts with childhood innocence and joy gradually touches upon a far heavier truth of our time.
